scope: Named provider keys, private metadata/selection IPC, atomic migration, trusted manager and actual credential switching through compiled OpenCode and the real gateway broker.
environment: Mac ARM64; Debian ARM/HVF outer VM; separate session and gateway guests under TCG. Synthetic credentials only.
network: Outer test VM has no NIC. Tor is disabled; the stream test uses a lab-only SOCKS/TLS provider inside the gateway. No real Abliteration request or key, external SOCKS configuration, or packet capture in these runs.

boundaries.chat_ui: No changes to upstream OpenCode chat TUI components; key administration is in the separate trusted host manager.
boundaries.persistence: Version 1 archive, root 0600 under general LUKS, at most 64 named keys; first key becomes default. Legacy format is read without writes, migrated on the first mutation; new archive is durable before deleting legacy files.
boundaries.selection: Only opaque selection ID in host tmpfs. Readonly permits this selection but rejects durable changes. Removing an active key leaves no selection, even when another default exists. No automatic key rotation or retries on a different account.
boundaries.delegation: Only the selected secret is delivered to the gateway; the session retains a revocable local token. Key changes require session closure and destroy the old gateway before updating selection. Same-key selection preserves the active gateway.
boundaries.trust_overlay: Same lab-only additional public fixture CA as stream-lifecycle; production broker source and fixed origin/public CA trust unchanged.
boundaries.diagnostics: Synthetic provider records only initial/alternate credential labels for stream IDs; no production secret or request content is logged.

session_cli.note: The raw runner opencode_sha256 describes the older base host image. The manifest-verified stream session image uses the adapter-broker CLI above.
